scientific.integrity: The exact Problem 4 statement and the primary 2009 survey were materially inspected in public full text, and the closest 1998 Radon-transform paper was materially inspected in full. The day-level date 2009-01-08 is independently recorded for Goodey's volume article. All new first-variation and harmonic-kernel steps are derived explicitly, and the algebraic identities are replayed from the packaged checker.
limitations: The theorem is an infinitesimal result at the four-dimensional ball, not a nonlinear local or global solution of Problem 4.
Odd support perturbations are invisible to both first-order data sets, so second-order effects remain unconstrained.
An equivalent tangent-space statement may be implicit in older transform literature.

source_ids: Banach Center Publications 84 (2009), Open Problem Session, Problem 4
title: Infinitesimal rigidity for Goodey's constant-surface-area projection problem
